guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) Truthfulness is the greatest of all the virtues because it embodies honesty and builds trust. (b) We cannot command the confidence of others unless we are truthful. (c) The man whom nobody believes is a liar. (d) A man may succeed once or twice by telling a lie, but he will not succeed in the long run. (e) When once one’s falsehood is brought to light, people will hate him.
